title: 6th Annual Applied Value Investing Stock Pitch Challenge
description: The 6th Annual Applied Value Investing Stock Pitch Challenge featuring the work for Value Investing Program students Morgan Zhang '25 - AO Smith  (first place), Mario Stefanidis - '25 CNH (second place), Harsha Mohan '25 - Global Payments, and Kit Popolo '25 – Ibotta, and presented by sponsors Artisan International Value, Summit Street Capital Management and CP&E Partners.
summary: The talk primarily argues that Global Payments (GPN) represents a compelling investment opportunity due to its strong management team, successful capital allocation strategy under CEO Cameron Brady, and attractive valuation. The speaker highlights the company's shift away from acquisitions toward significant share repurchases and dividends, which are expected to reduce share count and drive mid-teens returns even if the business merely maintains its current position. While other payment processors like Fiserv (FISV) and competitors like DoorDash (DASH) and Instacart (AMZN) are mentioned in the context of the broader payment ecosystem and Ibotta partnerships, the core investment thesis focuses on GPN's ability to deploy capital effectively and compete with digital-first peers.
